description.value: Donair Dude is a Vancouver-born Mediterranean fast-food chain that got its start during the 2010 Winter Olympics and has grown into a multi-location franchise. The Gastown location on West Hastings Street serves freshly prepared donairs, falafel wraps, platters, and poutine using BC-sourced meat roasted in-house. It offers a wide menu including chicken, beef, lamb, and vegan options, making it a solid calorie stop for cyclists moving through downtown Vancouver.
